2. Image Embeds and Dimension Stripping

Obsidian allows virtual image sizing tags (|300 or |600x400) that violate CommonMark. Kykloi should strip the virtual sizing parameters while preserving the link and descriptive alt text:

3. Callout Variants

The Lua filter converts standard > [!TYPE] blockquotes into semantic <aside> tags without injecting class wrappers.

[!NOTE] Default Note Admonition This is a default note callout. It provides contextual information that supplements the main body text.

[!WARNING] Critical Integrity Alert Passphrases used for /secure/ documents are never stored on the server. Loss of passphrase results in permanent data loss.

[!TIP] Keyboard Efficiency Pressing / or Ctrl+K on the index page immediately activates and focuses the SQLite search input.

[!IMPORTANT] A callout without an explicit title should automatically format its type into title case (e.g., Important).
